title: Futility look is one-sided: a skill trending to hurts stops at half the panel and is posted as not distinguished
acceptance: Stop for futility only when conditional power is under 10% for a true effect of both plus and minus the planned MDD, so a skill whose interim estimate favors none runs the full panel and can read hurts. Print the interim estimate, its 95% interval and its direction at every stop, and have R48 treat an interim estimate in none's favor as a loss lead, not a plain null. Add both cases to O5's keyless dry run.

title: The 1.5x cost-per-solved guard can't be passed by most wave-1 told skills at the plan's own 2.2x to 5.0x multiples, and the plan doesn't say whether it binds
acceptance: State whether the guard binds told skills and in which form (#169 binds it on H-inv as an upper bound <= 1.5, README.md:178). Print each skill's break-even gain beside its MDD in section 8 (at a 50% control rate: plan-eng-review +23, plan-devex-review and plan-design-review +30, devex-review +33, design-review +50, autoplan unreachable). Define solved for U's and X's cost figure, reuse #169's G3 definition in O4, and write the R48 rule that turns the ratio interval into KEEP or CUT-CANDIDATE. Ask Garry before admission whether 1.5x on hidden-test solves is the bar for a told skill.

title: The promise that wave 1 settles GST-1218 rests on an unnamed after pin and on a null inference the plan disowns
acceptance: Replace 'A null rules out a gain of that size' with an interval rule: a gain is ruled out only above the upper 95% bound of told minus none, or against F2's break-even gain. Tie GST-1218's keep-or-cut reading to a told arm on the named after pin. If the pin isn't named by G admission, tell the Captain then that plan-eng-review's and plan-devex-review's rows can only inform GST-1218 (a forced-line verdict can't KEEP or CUT, line 27), and let the Captain choose between waiting and reading the forced line as information.

title: Central prices sit at half the house's real-task central (R3 amendment 4: 5x Verified) and the price-risk case stresses only the none session
acceptance: Stress section 8 at the house central (5x Verified) and high (10x), with particle-1 at quick look 3's 0.41 of Opus, told multiples at 1.5x their central and the agent user at 2x, and print which rows survive and their MDDs. Show the wave-1 table's MDDs at both central and house central. Reuse R3 amendment 4's between-part projection check between admission, screening and confirmatory, so a stage that would push a skill's re-sized MDD past what can change its decision stops before it spends. Recheck particle-1's 2-point fit at admission's metered ratio before any particle-1 spend.

title: autoplan's told arm names no kind, voice count or gate setting; the before pin predates R66's kinds and the 5.0x price assumes the full panel
acceptance: Freeze autoplan's told invocation in O1: the kind (crews now run --kind feature on features), the phases scope chooses, the outside voice and its model, the gate answer, and the exact slash line per pin. Meter that configuration on admission sessions before autoplan's place, size and MDD in the wave-1 table are fixed, align the four-way stand-in with it, and name the configuration in every autoplan verdict. If the after pin's default kind differs, the prereg says which one it tests and why.

title: deferred from design: Agent user acts by role and accessible name at one 1280x720 viewport, so design-review's hierarchy, spacing, slop and mobile fixes and plan-design-review's responsive pass are invisible; the degraded fixture only tests a11y and function defects
acceptance: Make the primary agent user vision-first (screenshot plus coordinate actions, no a11y text), keep a11y mode as a sensitivity, run one scenario per task at 375 wide, and add visual degraded fixtures with an identical a11y tree (demoted primary action, competing primaries, key control below the fold, mobile overflow) to admission row 4

title: deferred from design: Scenario completion is confounded with functional correctness; a design skill can win family U by making the feature work, and band screening on completion selects functionally hard tasks
acceptance: Run a privileged reachability probe per scenario per tree; the design reading is completion on reachable scenarios, unconditional completion is a sensitivity; screen and admit on the conditioned reading and report 'helps by making it work' under its own name

title: deferred from design: Completion within a 25-step cap saturates for a frontier agent on any working UI; Krug claims effort and errors, which are only secondaries
acceptance: Freeze a per-scenario step budget from gold's pilot median (about 1.5 times, at most 25); primary is completed within budget, raw completion secondary; admission reads gold versus degraded on that measure

title: deferred from design: U's hidden-test guard includes the PR's selector-bound e2e tests, so arms that redesign the screen fail them and design skills get marked as tradeoffs for doing their job
acceptance: Guard on unit and integration tests only; print the PR e2e pass rate as a descriptive line outside the guard

title: deferred from design: No boot and seed contract for real web apps (database, migrations, seed, auth, stubbed services, offline); 'app does not start scores 0' mixes arm failures with rig failures and boot feasibility will cut U's yield
acceptance: Freeze a per-task boot contract at authoring and state it to every arm; classify boot failures as arm (unsolved) or rig (gap); add an admission row that gold and base boot in at least 90% of runs and report boot yield per mined repo in the thin slice

title: deferred from design: Scenarios are unspecified as to state, so three happy paths would leave plan-design-review's empty, loading, error and edge states unmeasured
acceptance: Freeze a scenario mix: where the feature has them, one scenario from the empty state and one requiring error recovery; tag scenarios by kind and print per-kind completion

title: deferred from design: U statements written from the PR and scenario goals that quote gold's labels leave design skills nothing to decide and hand the agent user gold's vocabulary
acceptance: U statements give goal, data and constraints, never layout or labels; scenario goals use user language with no control names; the auditor checks both

title: deferred from design: The agent user is selected on the same thin-slice fixtures the admission instrument row reads, and both candidates are models under test
acceptance: Select on half the fixtures and admit on the other half; add one cross-family candidate that is not a model under test

title: deferred from design: Judges compare screenshots whose states depend on each arm's agent-user path, with no order control or agreement statistic
acceptance: Scripted capture of defined states (entry, empty, error, checker state via the reachability probe) at 375 and 1280 wide; both orders; print judge agreement; pin the rubric by sha256

title: deferred from design: Both design skills' mockup steps need the gstack designer, which calls OpenAI's image API with OPENAI_API_KEY; the no-other-key pin disables them silently and the '7 passes in order' detector does not record it
acceptance: State that the designer is unavailable by construction in every U told cell, scope the claim to 'without generated mockups', and have the exposure detector record DESIGN_NOT_AVAILABLE; supplying a key needs its own route, price and OpenAI image terms check

title: deferred from design: R65 and custody: UI assets (fonts, icons, logos) carry licences and trademarks apart from the repo licence, and agent-user screenshots, aria snapshots, step logs and judge inputs reveal the repo and gold UI but are not in section 12's sealed list
acceptance: Add an asset-licence check to V8, publish no task-app screenshot, seal agent-user and judge artifacts as panel material, and send judge calls with a data-collection deny

title: deferred from design: design-review's exposure detector names the Trunk Test from 1.93.34.0; the after pin may rename or restructure it
acceptance: Freeze each design skill's exposure detector from the confirmatory pin's files, with keyless fixtures from that pin

title: deferred from dx: Base-tree check cannot detect docs saturation: it tests whether the goal needs the feature, not whether it needs the docs; section 14's claim is wrong
acceptance: Add a per-task docs-sensitivity fixture (gold artifact and gold --help, with the base tree's doc files) and an admission row: first success on gold docs at least 30 points above gold code with base docs, mirroring U's degraded-fixture drop; correct section 14

title: deferred from dx: Goal 'use the new <feature> to <outcome>' names the feature that V4 already names in the statement, so the docs-only agent can find it in --help without the arm's docs
acceptance: Write X goals in user words that state the outcome and withhold the feature's name; have the checker confirm the new surface ran (an exec-log shim or an outcome only that surface produces), and keep the base-tree check

title: deferred from dx: CAP4:docs-only harness:channel interactive CLIs (TUIs, prompts, pagers; the probe's fzf --bind feature is one) can hang a no-terminal agent with no non-interactive rule or per-command timeout
acceptance: Admit only goals completable non-interactively (or provide a scripted pty such as tmux with a documented driver), set a per-command timeout, set PAGER=cat and CI=1, and score a timed-out command as a failed command, never a gap

title: deferred from dx: What counts as docs is defined three ways (section 3 list, section 10 'every doc file', arm-created files unaddressed), and 'no source tree' is unenforceable for Python and npm packages whose installed files are source
acceptance: Freeze one doc-set rule per repo at authoring (globs from what the repo ships at base plus matching files the arm adds, plus --help and type files built from the arm's tree), and either declare installed package contents part of the published surface or restrict X to compiled CLIs in the pilot

title: deferred from dx: Family X has no task file contract: goal file, checker interface and timing (after each turn or at the end), build recipe, offline dependency install, doc globs and artifact class are unnamed, so O3 and T-X will guess
acceptance: Add X rows to the lane's task SPEC table (goal.md, docs-globs, build.sh with an offline mirror, check.sh with exit-code contract, run after every turn and read-only to the agent) before thin-slice authoring

title: deferred from dx: CAP6:docs-only build:recovery an arm tree that fails to build or install the artifact, and a docs-only run lost to a provider error, have no rule separating arm failure (score 0) from rig gap, and no recovery
acceptance: Score an arm-caused build or install failure as 0 with its cause printed; treat a measurement-agent upstream or rig failure as a gap rerun once with a named repair, counted under the 5% NO READ rule; give each a reason code in src/errors/codes.ts

title: deferred from dx: X images carry no browser, but devex-review drives Aside or gstack's $B, asks for a docs URL in Step 0 and says to stop rather than substitute curl when no browser exists, so its told arm may stop before Step 1
acceptance: Put Playwright and Chromium in X images for every arm as U does, and run a $0 probe of devex-review on a CLI fixture under the simulated user; read exposure from its gstack-review-log row (tthw_measured, dimensions_tested)

title: deferred from dx: X yield is overstated: the DX tag (docs plus any index.ts, __init__.py, lib.rs or schema file) catches internal refactors and web-app APIs (memos leads), and X has no mining scope while U has 60 repositories
acceptance: Tighten the tag to public-surface changes with a user doc change, list X's artifact classes (CLI binary, library package; servers deferred or given a boot contract), and set an X mining target sized to about 360 valid candidates

title: deferred from dx: Admission row 4's docs-only bar has no unit and no per-task validity rule, so two broken goals can fail a whole family
acceptance: Add V11: a task enters the pool only if gold reaches first success in at least 2 of 3 runs and base in 0 of 2; keep the family row as pooled over valid tasks

title: deferred from dx: plan-devex-review asks for a mode under the simulated user: EXPANSION proposes scope beyond the statement, TRIAGE traces only install and hello world, and the '8 passes in order' detector ignores the mode
acceptance: Freeze the mode the simulated user picks (POLISH for enhancement tasks) or record the mode and score exposure per mode's required passes

title: deferred from dx: autoplan on family X counts as exposed when its own scope detector skips the DX phase, so autoplan (DX scope) can be scored without any DX review
acceptance: For X rows, require the DX phase in autoplan's run.json as part of exposure, and report how often scope detection chose DX

title: deferred from dx: X primary is confounded with build and correctness, and the hidden-test guard ('losing more than 10 points') has no statistic
acceptance: Print the X primary on the subset where both arms' trees pass hidden tests as a sensitivity; define the guard as the 95% interval of told minus none on hidden tests lying wholly below minus 10 points

title: deferred from dx: The plan names lanes/outcome-skills/ but no src/cli.ts row, subcommands, registry schema or reason codes, which AGENTS.md requires for every new command
acceptance: State whether outcome-skills is a new cli row or subcommands of 'real', name each unit's entry command and its first smoke test, and list the reason codes O1 to O5 add

title: deferred from dx: Wall time to first success mixes provider latency into a secondary
acceptance: Report turns, tokens and failed commands to first success; keep wall time descriptive only

title: deferred from dx: The fixed docs-only reader is Opus 5.5, the same family as the Opus row's writer, which may favour Opus-written docs over Sol and particle-1 docs
acceptance: State the asymmetry in each X verdict, and in the pilot run a second reader family on a sample to size it

title: deferred from dx: R65: docs may carry a licence apart from the code, and docs-only images bundle the artifact's dependency closure
acceptance: Record a declared docs licence beside the SPDX id in V8, and state that task images stay private so dependency redistribution terms never apply

title: Per-skill plans assume both skills in a family pass admission; a lone survivor costs $1,986 to $2,376 at its planned size
acceptance: Price the one-survivor branch per family in section 8. At planned sizes the survivor pays every unspent shared cost (bulk authoring, screening, the whole none arm, the prereg thread) and costs autoplan $1,986, plan-eng-review $2,272, plan-devex-review $2,357, devex-review $2,376, plan-design-review $2,319 and design-review $2,237. Freeze a re-size rule (drop the particle-1 row first, then trials, then tasks) and print the MDD it buys (about 15 to 17 in G and X, 18.6 to 19.2 in U), or stop the survivor when that MDD passes the bound in F4. Apply the same rule when one skill stops at the futility look.

title: Told prices come from sessions where the procedure mostly did not run, and the forced arm that decision 3 expects to run has no price
acceptance: Add forced and told-exposed price rows to section 8. The only metered told session (R3a told /investigate, $0.424) had exposure 2 of 10, E0's $0.236 is a plain none session, and v2 deleted v1's forced row (told plus 15%, with panel v3's forced lines at 1.7 times told on plan units). Price the confirmatory on the arm that will run: forced at told x1.15 central and x1.5 as the risk case (planned designs $1,704 to $1,777 and $1,836 to $2,081, autoplan over its ceiling; re-sized G MDDs 14.4/15.0 and 16.2/15.6). Have admission meter exposed and unexposed told sessions separately, and freeze the pin at admission: a pin named after admission needs a new admission paid from the reserve.

title: Authoring is priced at TS's paid author and audit spend; the crew thread that mined, built, checked and sealed the tasks cost about five times that and has no line
acceptance: Add a crew line per valid task for mining, building, checking and sealing, measured on each family's thin-slice thread and re-sized at admission. TS spent $7.93 of author and auditor calls plus $1.78 of VM for 7 valid tasks while its thread used about 43,500 credits before its /ship tail (GEVA-173.md:16), about $6.20 a valid task. Wave 1 needs about 800 valid tasks (G 372, U 192, X 237). At a fifth of TS's rate the planned designs cost $1,761 to $1,912 and re-size to MDDs of G 14.4/15.0, U 15.6 and X 14.4; at TS's full rate G alone needs about $2,300, more than both G reserves. Also price two preregs per family (admission and confirmatory) inside the $70 line, not one.
